updateHandling.previousCause: Any update/changed lifecycle was rejected before exact issue-time and candidate checks, producing source_updated
updateHandling.acceptedLifecycle: Current QWeather page update may match only with exact Apple issuedTime, strict region/type/severity, and one unique candidate
updateHandling.staleAppleRule: A newer same-type update rejects older Apple data as source_update_newer_candidate
updateHandling.mismatchRule: Nonmatching update issue time returns source_update_version_mismatch
updateHandling.cancelRule: cancel/解除 and unknown lifecycle are never candidates
updateHandling.htmlIdentityLimit: Public page parsing has no structured QWeather alert id/supersedes chain; exact issue time plus current page and strict predicates is the available binding evidence, not an API-level identity proof
updateHandling.collectionRewriteRule: All Apple events must uniquely match; any one failure returns the complete original collection and links; no per-event partial rewriting.
